description: For an infinite cardinal \(\kappa\), finite tuples \(\bar a,\bar b\) with equal actual complete types over \(A\subseteq M\), where \(|A|<\kappa\), determine a partial elementary self-map with domain exactly \(A\cup\{a_i:i<n\}\), fixing every point of \(A\) and taking every \(a_i\) to the corresponding \(b_i\). Its domain still has size below \(\kappa\).
